metadata.question: Did active fire detections in Sumatra and Borneo, Indonesia, increase in 2023 compared to 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use the MODIS FireCCI v6.1 collection 'ESA/CCI/FireCCI/61/v1' which provides monthly fire pixel counts by land cover class. - Areas: Sumatra and Borneo polygons (built from a few representative coordinates that cover each island). - Periods: 2022-01-01 → 2022-12-31 and 2023-01-01 → 2023-12-31. 2. Masking strategy: No cloud/snow masking needed – the CCI product is already a mask of fire presence per 250 m pixel. 3. Logic: Sum the ‘Forest’, ‘Shrub’, ‘Grass’, ‘Crop’ and ‘Other’ layers across all months within each year to get total detected fire pixels for 2022 vs 2023. - If either yearly total is exactly 0 pixels, flag C2 (valid images but no fire detections). - If the reducer returns None/NaN, flag C3. - Otherwise, compare 2023 total > 2022 total → A (Yes), else B (No). ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # --- 1. Geometry: rough hand-digitised polygons for Sumatra & Borneo sumatra = ee.Geometry.Polygon( [[[95, 6], [105, 6], [105, -6], [95, -6], [95, 6]]]) borneo = ee.Geometry.Polygon( [[[108, 8], [120, 8], [120, -5], [108, -5], [108, 8]]]) roi = sumatra.union(borneo) # --- 2. Load MODIS FireCCI 61 monthly fire pixels def yearly_total(year): col = (ee.ImageCollection('ESA/CCI/FireCCI/61/v1') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(f'{year}-01-01', f'{year}-12-31')) n = col.size().getInfo() if n == 0: return None # Sum all fire-pixel bands (Forest,Shrub,Grass,Crop,Other) sumImg = col.select(['Forest','Shrub','Grass','Crop','Other']).sum() tot = (sumImg.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=roi, scale=2500, maxPixels=1e9) .values().reduce(ee.Reducer.sum())).getInfo()) return tot t22 = yearly_total(2022) t23 = yearly_total(2023) print(f'2022 total fire pixels: {t22}') print(f'2023 total fire pixels: {t23}') if t22 is None or t23 is None: print('C1') elif t22 == 0 and t23 == 0: print('C2') elif t22 is None or t23 is None or (t22 != t22) or (t23 != t23): # NaN guard print('C3') elif t23 > t22: print('A') else: print('B') ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# --- 1. Geometry: rough hand-digitised polygons for Sumatra & Borneo
sumatra = ee.Geometry.Polygon(
    [[[95, 6], [105, 6], [105, -6], [95, -6], [95, 6]]])
borneo = ee.Geometry.Polygon(
    [[[108, 8], [120, 8], [120, -5], [108, -5], [108, 8]]])
roi = sumatra.union(borneo)

# --- 2. Load MODIS FireCCI 61 monthly fire pixels
def yearly_total(year):
    col = (ee.ImageCollection('ESA/CCI/FireCCI/61/v1')
           .filterBounds(roi)
           .filterDate(f'{year}-01-01', f'{year}-12-31'))
    n = col.size().getInfo()
    if n == 0:
        return None
    # Sum all fire-pixel bands (Forest,Shrub,Grass,Crop,Other)
    sumImg = col.select(['Forest','Shrub','Grass','Crop','Other']).sum()
    tot = (sumImg.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
                               geometry=roi, scale=2500, maxPixels=1e9)
                 .values().reduce(ee.Reducer.sum())).getInfo())
    return tot

t22 = yearly_total(2022)
t23 = yearly_total(2023)

print(f'2022 total fire pixels: {t22}')
print(f'2023 total fire pixels: {t23}')

if t22 is None or t23 is None:
    print('<answer>C1</answer>')
elif t22 == 0 and t23 == 0:
    print('<answer>C2</answer>')
elif t22 is None or t23 is None or (t22 != t22) or (t23 != t23):  # NaN guard
    print('<answer>C3</answer>')
elif t23 > t22:
    print('<answer>A</answer>')
else:
    print('<answer>B</answer>')
